name: Church of Scotland (Scottish Metrical Psalter)
bio: The Scottish Metrical Psalter of 1650 is the verse psalter approved by the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland for use in public worship. It revised the metrical version of the English Puritan Francis Rous (1579–1659), first published in 1643, after the Westminster Assembly had commended it, and was set mostly in common metre. It remained the psalter sung in the Scottish Kirk for centuries and includes the familiar metrical Twenty-third Psalm, ‘The Lord’s my shepherd, I’ll not want’.
